title: Grateful Dead Live at Zoo Amphitheater on 1982-08-01
lineage: Anne Cohen : AD Transfer - Master Cassettes played on Nakamichi Dragon > HHB CDR800 > CD Ohr : CD > EAC > WAV > FLAC
source: Master Audience Cassettes - recorded by Ohr Weinberg: 2 Sony ECM-23F microphones > Sony TC-D5M Cassette Deck (1st & 2nd Sets: Maxell MX 90 Cassettes), Dolby B

ai_review.summary: A hot, fun day at the Zoo with a strong set (Playing In The Band, Lost Sailor, China > Rider) and a generally good listening experience despite no detailed recording notes.
ai_review.review: The show captures a sunny Oklahoma City afternoon where Jerry’s birthday celebration sparked an upbeat vibe. Highlights include a blazing Playing In The Band opening, a smooth Lost Sailor → Saint of Circumstance sequence, and a heartfelt Black Peter, while the recording itself is unremarked on but appears listenable enough for fans. Overall the performance feels high‑energy and enjoyable.

ai_rating.rationale: One detailed, positive review indicates a strong musical performance; no concrete recording quality comments, so rating leans on show impression.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Review does not mention sound clarity or mix issues; no complaints suggest the recording is at least listenable.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: Set flows smoothly from early acoustic numbers to jam-heavy mid‑section, with a lively second half that keeps the crowd moving despite heat.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Eases temperature with sweet "They Love Each Other" and delivers a mournful Black Peter; his playing is highlighted throughout.
band_member_comments.Bob: Provides fine vocals on "C.C. Rider", "Me & My Uncle", and "Big River"; noted for solid rhythm work.
